catalog.agent_visibility: Complete raw materials, answers and references may be selected for an Environment; the developer controls their use.
catalog.archive_scope: Selected upstream archive; external build dependencies and separately distributed datasets are excluded.
catalog.container_strategy: Build fixed algorithm/dispatch variants in dev; run result-checked length and alignment strata on target.

corpus_contract.code: Library, CLI and sanity tests included.
corpus_contract.inputs: Seeded deterministic byte buffers and fixed representative files.
corpus_contract.oracle: Published/upstream hash test vectors and independent reference outputs.
corpus_contract.split_unit: Hash algorithm family, not each buffer length.

catalog.purpose: Fast integer and SIMD hashing over input lengths, alignments and distributions.
qualification_gaps: Tiny cases require batching and overhead calibration; expose both throughput and latency strata without double counting them.
catalog.size_basis: Measured HTTP response body and SHA256; logical size sums regular archive file entries, excluding filesystem allocation, submodule payloads and external datasets.
catalog.title: xxHash hashing workload

activation: Query cpg packages paths xxhash and use the selected installation prefix explicitly.
Optionally add <prefix>/bin to PATH and <prefix>/lib/pkgconfig to PKG_CONFIG_PATH. No global library-path override is required for the bundled API probe.

examples.command: cpg packages info xxhash --json; cpg packages paths xxhash; cpg packages check xxhash --prefix <prefix>
examples.description: Inspect the selected copy and run bounded checks
Link against the selected C library

examples.command: cpg packages pack packages/xxhash/package.json --definition --method source --source xxhash=/path/to/locked-archive --recipe packages/xxhash/recipe --output xxhash.source.cpgpkg.tar.gz
examples.description: Package the source/build view using the existing definition entry point

examples.command: cpg packages pack packages/xxhash/material-profile.json --definition --method material --payload /path/to/verified-unpacked-source --output xxhash.material.cpgpkg.tar.gz
examples.description: Package the same ID as complete raw material

examples.command: cpg packages pack packages/xxhash/package.json --definition --method binary --payload <checked-prefix> --recipe packages/xxhash/recipe --relocatable --output xxhash.binary.cpgpkg.tar.gz
examples.description: Package a checked independent installation for relocation

notes: Two maintained definitions share this existing resource ID: package.json builds/installs tools; material-profile.json preserves the original catalog definition byte for byte. Select the definition explicitly with pack --definition. Neither view removes or forbids the other.

Build profile: Ubuntu 24.04 x86_64, exact existing apt.build-essential=12.10ubuntu1 and apt.python3=3.12.3-0ubuntu2.1 declarations; /usr/bin/cc and /usr/bin/python3 are used. The underlying APT manager retains transitive dependency resolution.

Source builds run upstream make check and make test-xxhsum-c before install. Installed checks execute the package-local shared library against upstream vectors, streaming/alignment cases and four CLI checksum families with deliberate corruption.

CLI and library runtime dispatch are enabled; no -march=native tuning is applied. This qualification does not establish portable behavior on every CPU, sanitizer cleanliness, collision properties, benchmark scores or full upstream test-matrix coverage.

Binary packaging excludes local prefix ownership metadata and preserves all other files. The relocation claim must pass checks in independent fresh prefixes on the same declared target before publication.

The original material profile has no executable checks: integrity and complete file inventory are verified, while tool/version/function checks are not_run. Its original metadata.catalog qualification values remain historical facts, not rewritten claims.
Do not infer the raw source path from a binary-only receipt. Install the material/source artifact as well when raw workload sources, tests or references are desired.
usage.summary: xxHash v0.8.4: four hashing families, checked CLI and installed shared/static C libraries; the same resource also retains its complete original source/test material profile.
